sample_unit: lay adult raters (plus 5 otolaryngologist experts rating 20 AI-generated consent forms)

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL) of AI-generated consent forms versus official templates and target reading level
links.effect: Mean FKGL lower for AI forms than official templates; prompts targeted 6th-8th grade but achieved scores were slightly higher (8.8-9.4).
links.quote: Although prompts targeted a 6th-8th grade reading level, achieved readability scores were slightly higher (8.8-9.4).

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated consent materials relative to intended user level
links.effect: AI forms had lower FKGL than official templates but exceeded the 6th-8th grade target, reaching 8.8-9.4.
links.quote: Mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level was lower for AI-generated forms compared to official templates.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to generate procedure-specific surgical consent forms with expert and lay-rater evaluation

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM-generated surgical consent forms assessed by both otolaryngologists and lay raters, comparing model outputs against each other and official templates without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
